reasons.correctness: All interface names match. Case-insensitive lookup, PLN fixed at 1, HALF_UP rounding to 2 decimals, and BusinessRuleTranslatableException with key and ISO arg are present. Build green, hidden 5/5, existing 41/41.
reasons.convention_fit: ExchangeRatePort is in currency/port and FixedExchangeRateAdapter in currency/adapter. The service depends only on the port. Explicit constructors with private final fields. The i18n key is in both messages_en and messages_pl. New *UnitTest classes use MockitoExtension.
reasons.design_fit: Small, cohesive footprint that follows the VatRegistryPort/BialaListaVatAdapter structure. Rates live in application.yml under currency.fixed-rates. The adapter's upper-casing plus equalsIgnoreCase stream is slightly redundant but harmless.
reasons.test_quality: Tests cover conversion, HALF_UP rounding, missing rate (key and args), case-insensitive match, PLN=1 and unknown code. No Spring context. Null isoCode and a mixed-case map key are untested. The adapter test has MockitoExtension but no mocks.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries found the currency entities, existing Port/Adapter/Properties files and the TranslatableException hierarchy before editing. The agent then read VatRegistryPort, BialaListaVatAdapter and RegistryProperties and mirrored them.
